needs.what: `min_colors` (two or more colors, 202.2b) accepted in a battlefield static's `affects` filter (STATIC_AFFECTS_FILTER_KEYS), so a `buff` can read {"controller": "you", "types": ["Creature"], "min_colors": 2, "exclude_self": true}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `min_colors` exists in trigger filters, selectors and OFF_BATTLEFIELD_AFFECTS_KEYS, and characteristics._matches_printed already reads it, but loader._check_static_affects rejects it on a battlefield static. `colors` is a membership test (`["W","U"]` matches a mono-white creature), so neither it nor an `any_of` of colour pairs can say multicolored.
